title: depclaims: published cancer cell growth claims calibrated against genome-wide screens
description: An atlas of 13,610 published claims that silencing a gene reduces the growth of a named human cancer cell line, each scored against DepMap CRISPR and RNA-interference screens and gene expression of the same gene in the same line, with all 17,920 extracted statements, a per-gene summary, the depclaims Python package that scores any such claim, and the analysis code.
